timing_boundary: No timing or memory measurements may be compared across the RTX 3070 and RTX A5000. The RTX 3070 only produces the fixed draft artifact; every comparative serving measurement is made on the same A5000 pod.
interpretation: Results will be described as A5000-specific serving measurements with a draft trained on an RTX 3070, not as RTX 3070 serving results. This amendment changes infrastructure only and creates no new scientific comparison.
